nodes.label: historical-replay-v1
nodes.rationale: A separately versioned offline approximation uses retrospectively selected FTFT/SES/TE across four sessions. Account, cost and timing values are engineering fixtures. Zero trades is valid; the pilot is neither original-alert reconstruction nor independent validation.

nodes.label: Archived historical information clock
nodes.rationale: Preserve original payloads, nanosecond timestamps, order and hashes without credentials. Actual historical receipts are unknown, so acquisition time cannot replace them. Decisions use modeled arrivals and fixed share-basis normalization; missing bars, invalid quotes and unknown halt coverage remain explicit.

nodes.label: Shared-portfolio capacity-limited IOC simulation
nodes.rationale: Decimal accounting reserves cash/risk across symbols and sessions. Entries use strictly later admissible quotes and 25% displayed ask capacity; first positive fills cancel remainder. Unchanged prices do not replenish consumed capacity. Delayed exits retain unresolved exposure instead of inventing closing fills.

nodes.label: Archive-verified replay pilot CLI
nodes.rationale: Only download uses credentials; run consumes local archives offline. Existing configs are preserved, downloads require fresh destinations and resumption verifies request sequence/hashes. Outputs include ledgers, source/input hashes and repeat equality; source or dataset changes during execution fail the run.
